followup_reviews.Research finding: Retain the inherited Ken-Sai–Uch-Kurgan interruption and September 2024 restoration, while preserving the contested earlier chronology. The restoration concerns a multilateral road post for people, vehicles, goods and animals. Kara-Suu’s bilateral/daytime passenger rules are not transferred to Ken-Sai. Retain observed restoration on 12 September 2024, unknown onset and withheld duration/continuity. The correspondent’s retrospective since-2009 wording and the guide’s intermediate 2016–2018 events remain unresolved rather than blended into a fabricated interval. Retain Uncoded for the original closure reason. Cooperation and modernization at reopening do not establish the original restriction motive. Azattyq supplies a contemporary correspondent account. The exact saved Caravanistan indexed extract is reused only to preserve the chronology conflict after current direct failure; guide statements are not upgraded into verified intermediate events. Retain unlocated Ken-Sai–Uch-Kurgan scope with null coordinates. Post identity and guide chronology require resolution; no nearby Kara-Suu location or national border line is inherited.
